err.senderRequired: Enter the sender number. It must be pre-registered with the provider.
알리고(aligo.in)에서 발급한 API 키를 입력하세요. 발신번호는: Enter the API key issued by Aligo (aligo.in). Under Korean law the sender number must be pre-registered with the provider. SMS is billed per message, so each feature decides separately whether to use it.
Leave blank to keep the stored value.
Only a number pre-registered with the provider can be used (Korean Telecommunications Business Act).
